premises.text: Current ward practice and plain cameras fail to proactively detect patient deterioration between infrequent wired checks
premises.evidence_span: Cameras are great if you're watching them for context and gross information, but they won't ever, on their own, proactively alert you to deterioration

premises.text: OxyCAM software on cameras plus cloud delivers medical-grade vital signs, activity status, and nursing-station alerts matching contact-device accuracy
premises.evidence_span: that solution delivers to the nursing station real-time alerts, vital signs, and if the nurse chooses, video on demand

premises.text: Market first with video activity analytics, then medical-device vital-sign analytics
premises.evidence_span: We're going to market in two phases

premises.text: Video-camera platform with activity, vitals, and context is ideal for reallocating scarce clinician time and enabling lower-cost care settings
premises.evidence_span: we believe that video cameras, empowered by OxyCAM software, are the ideal platform. Activity, vital signs, and context all in one place
